answer: A mechanism that actually bites: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because cipher only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. In practice oasis is enforced by the ledger itself: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any lantern approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
